title: Approximation by mixtures of multivariate Erlang distributions
summary: We prove that finite multivariate Erlang mixture densities with a common rate parameter are dense in the class of probability densities on $\mathbb{R}_{+}^{d}$ that belong to $L^{p}$, for every dimension $d\in\mathbb{N}$ and every $1\le p<\infty$. The argument is constructive: the one-dimensional Szász--Mirakjan--Kantorovich operator yields Erlang mixture approximations, and its tensor product yields multivariate approximants with a common scale.
